CREATE TABLE "public"."agentAvailability" (
  "agentId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dayOfWeek" int4 NOT NULL,
  "endTime" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text DEFAULT 'Africa/Lagos' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."agentAvailabilityException" (
  "agentId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inspection" (
  "cancelReason" text,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "cancelledByUserId" text,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectorId" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectorKind" text DEFAULT 'LISTING_AGENT' NOT NULL,
  "listingId" text NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" text NOT NULL,
  "requesterId" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduledAt" timestamptz,
  "startedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inspection_inspectorKind_check_16a62507" CHECK ("inspectorKind" IN ('LISTING_AGENT', 'PRODUCT_Z_AGENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "inspection_status_check_f2d1a037" CHECK ("status" IN ('REQUESTED', 'SCHEDULED', 'STARTED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inspectionReview" (
  "agentRating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "agentText" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "propertyRating" int4,
  "propertyText" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."listing" (
  "bathrooms" int4,
  "bedrooms" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "description" text,
  "displayLocation" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "features" json,
  "flagReason" text,
  "flaggedAt" timestamptz,
  "flaggedByUserId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectionFeeDiscouraged" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" text NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "sizeSqm" float8,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_kind_check_9d7d9cf3" CHECK ("kind" IN ('RENT', 'SALE')),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_status_check_adf6a6a7" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'FILLED', 'EXPIRED', 'WITHDRAWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."listingFee" (
  "amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'NGN' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "listingId" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "listingFee_type_check_241115d0" CHECK ("type" IN ('LEGAL', 'CAUTION', 'SERVICE_CHARGE', 'AGENCY', 'INSPECTION_FEE', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."listingMedia" (
  "caption" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "listingId" text NOT NULL,
  "mediaId" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."listingPrice" (
  "amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'NGN' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "listingId" text NOT NULL,
  "period" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "years" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "listingPrice_period_check_ad9da072" CHECK ("period" IN ('MONTHLY', 'YEARLY', 'TOTAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."listingReferral" (
  "anonymousId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "listingId" text NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."media" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByUserId" text,
  "durationSeconds" int4,
  "height" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mime" text NOT NULL,
  "purpose" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  "width" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "media_purpose_check_00090244" CHECK ("purpose" IN ('PROPERTY_PHOTO', 'LISTING_PHOTO')),
  CONSTRAINT "media_status_check_a888db48" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'READY', 'FAILED', 'DELETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."propertyMedia" (
  "caption" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hiddenAt" timestamptz,
  "hiddenByMergeId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mediaId" text NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "source" text DEFAULT 'OWNER_UPLOAD' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "propertyMedia_source_check_732038a2" CHECK ("source" IN ('OWNER_UPLOAD', 'LISTING_PROMOTED', 'OPS_CURATED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."propertyMerge" (
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromPropertyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "reversedAt" timestamptz,
  "reversedById" text,
  "toPropertyId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."report" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "reporterId" text NOT NULL,
  "resolutionNotes" text,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "resolvedByUserId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "targetId" text NOT NULL,
  "targetType" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "report_reason_check_1997ed77" CHECK ("reason" IN ('MISREPRESENTATION', 'FRAUD', 'SPAM', 'INAPPROPRIATE_CONTENT', 'DUPLICATE_LISTING', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "report_status_check_0cd47f74" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'RESOLVED', 'DISMISSED')),
  CONSTRAINT "report_targetType_check_eb96de13" CHECK ("targetType" IN ('LISTING', 'AGENT', 'PROPERTY', 'USER'))
)
